summary: The 8-K reports the effectiveness of the S-1 registration and the consummation of Viking Acquisition Corp. II's initial public offering of 23,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $230 million in gross proceeds. Each unit comprises one Class A ordinary share and one-third of a redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The filing also includes standard IPO-related agreements, but no special-situations event such as a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, or restructuring. This is a routine SPAC IPO filing, not a special situation.
